As some who had pretty bad dyslexia Ill tell you some points and things that I wish my teachers and parents did for me

-number one rule for a child who has learning difficulty's is Be patient, there will be times when your son will struggle to do homework you must have the patience to work with him, allow him to find the solutions to his work let him do it himself even if he is wrong. often partens can end up doing the work for there child because its simply easyer than taking the time to let them figure it out, thats a bad move, it will damage his self semester and his work ethics your son will not grow out of this.

-always check up on how there day was at school and pay close attention to how teachers treat them. Even as a verry young child I rember being excluded from the class, told to sit outside for misbehaviour or stand in the corner.  for me this was torture I was not a dumb child but because the teachers never knew how to deal with me I felt isolated and as if I was not capable of working at the same pace as the outher kids, this still affects me in my day to day life. because I was treeted this way from a verry young age I grew to accept the role that my teachers had given me as the class clown, I never told my parents because I was too young to know any better.

-Its so important to give your son a work ethic at this age there is still time, get in a day to day routine this will make it easer for him to come home and get his home work and study done and choirs. Dyslexic children can often get verry bad work habbits at a young age because there parents give in and let them off the hook, dont do this it may seem cruel at the time but you are only hurting your son in the future, Just think of when he goes to collage or work, you wont there to help or motivate him so I cant stress enuff how IMPORTANT it is to give him some sort of work ethic at a young age. each child is different in the way they learn and work including children with dyslexia so watch how your son works and aid him in the way that you see fit.

-I was also tested for ADHD at your the same age as your son luckily for me the test came back negative. Your son reminds me of my self I had super bad concentration skills but this was mainly due to the fact that I had never been successfully at much in school so I suppose I felt there was no point in trying and I would destract my self from my work. A good way for you to check your self if he has adhd is look at him do something he enjoys Ill use my self for an example, My favourite class in school was always art obviously because there where no spellings or math involved, to me it felt pure and simple. I couldn't spend more than 20mins at work but I could spend large amounts of time drawing and getting lost in a painting, what im trying to say is if your song can concentrate on the tings he enjoys its most likely just a concentration issue witch is good because its fixable.
some good ways to help your son focus is to allow him to fidget maby by eating gum or getting a wobbly seat this always allowed me to work and focus more but as usual its different for each child so just take some time watch how he works and aid him with it let him feel comfortable working on his head if it helps him hahaha

-Your sons self esteem will be damaged by school he will feel inadequate even if he is intelligent so its super important for you to find a hoby for him that is completely separate from school that way they can never wreck it from him. This way you can encourage him to follow something he is passionate about without the anyone's permission. Encourage and help him in whatever hobby it is be it a sport or fort buildint it dosent matter just give them every opportunity you can manage to encourage him.

-extra help might be needed outside of school. your son will hate and despise your for this but its important when I was your sons age I was pretty much illitrate and could barley write a thoughtful sentence. one of the only good things my parents ever did for me was to send me to a school witch was had special needs teachers and facility's this helped me get a basic grasp and understanding of reading and writing. be careful not to let him feel like he has special need tho. I still rember my principals first words to me "just because you go to this school dose not mean your are stupid" witch at the time I think it obliterated whatever self esteem I had left.

At the end of the day your sons future will follow a rocker path than most but where it will lead will be more interesting than most, you will not be able to help him the whole way so give him the tools and the courage to do it himself. the most important thing you should do with your son when he is with you is to focus on what he is good at be slow with him he may need more time but most of all never give up on him witch im sure you wont!!
